fact: The 2025 appropriation summary for the Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, printed 16 May 2025, carries sub-programme 01106 Births and Deaths Registration Services (01106000 Births and Deaths Data Management) at GHS 7,409,170: GHS 500,000 from the Government of Ghana and GHS 6,909,170 from internally generated funds, with nothing under donors.
title: 1.5. Appropriation Bill: Summary of Expenditure by Sub-Programme, Economic Item and Funding. Entity: 011 - Ministry of Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs. Year: 2025
